integrity: The all-parameter statement is proved by a character obstruction plus an explicit affine permutation implementer. Finite exact checks are corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The result is specific to the two-copy natural permutation representation \(W=V\oplus V\) of \(D_n\), with \(n\ge3\). It corrects only the discrete unitary-normalizer quotient; it does not challenge the code construction, syndrome count, centralizer, or later restricted-error-group analysis.
title: Parity obstruction in the unitary normalizer of the two-copy dihedral permutation code
